'''The Maneater''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from [[Hidesplitter's Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Rragar Maneater]] and [[Hidesplitter]] in [[Rragar's Menagerie]].

== Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +15 
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) 
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Divine Favor]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) 
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Crescent Staff]] [[dye]]d green.
